$comment: Exact versions of everything vendored into a build. Committed; the
binaries themselves never are - CI builds them from these pins and
uploads them as artefacts. Changing a pin is a pull request with a
reason, and it re-runs the parity check in docs/adr/spikes/loom-native.md.

loom.note: Head of master on 2026-09-07. The published maps were built from an unpinned master build; the spike checks whether that output matches this commit.

loom_windows_port.note: MSYS2/UCRT64 build scripts and compatibility patches for Windows.

engine.note: A line order that keeps the lines it does not name. At v0.8.1 a cancelled feeds.add keeps nothing and a feed's own colour cannot become markup; at v0.8.2 map.build's line_order is a preference rather than a whitelist, so the lines it names are drawn first and every other line the layout carries follows, which is what the app's line-order panel sends (A4-02, engine issue 28). Both are additive at protocol 1 by the engine's convention, so the tag is the gate. The handshake compares version and protocol with engine.info and refuses any other; the vendoring job installs the package at the tag.

python.note: Upstream publishes no checksum manifest and no per-asset .sha256, so these hashes were computed on first download and are what every later build is checked against. A changed hash means the asset changed, which is the point.
python.licence_check: Verified 2026-09-07: the interpreter links libedit, not GNU readline, and _dbm links only libSystem - no GDBM. Both are GPL components that must stay out; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The Windows asset, listed 2026-09-12, has no readline and no _dbm or _gdbm extension; darwin-x64 has the same names as darwin-arm64.

ffmpeg.note: Prebuilt static GPL builds of FFmpeg 9.0, ffmpeg and ffprobe only (the engine finds ffprobe beside SCHEMATIC_FFMPEG by name). The three shipped targets are the n9.0.1 release from two builders; linux-x64 is for tests only and is BtbN's release/9.0 branch at n9.0.1-11, because martin-riedl.de's Linux build is configured --enable-nonfree --enable-decklink and may not be redistributed. The sha256 of every archive was computed on download on 2026-09-12 and matches what each builder publishes (martin-riedl.de's .sha256 files, GitHub's asset digests, BtbN's checksums.sha256). `reports` is what `ffmpeg -version` must print after 'ffmpeg version '.
ffmpeg.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later: every target's configure line carries --enable-gpl and --enable-version3, and none carries --enable-nonfree

win-x64.build_scripts: not published; the build's README.txt lists every library and its version

linux-x64.build_scripts: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds (the release autobuild-2026-08-31-13-27; month-end builds are kept for two years)
